title: tetradium glabrifolium
intro: Tetradium glabrifolium, commonly known as the Chinese Pepper or Fruiting Evodia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tetradium glabrifolium include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects, which contribute to its use in treating pain, inflammation, and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include lignans, coumarins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
